gates.description: Phase 4 requires an immutable, reviewed completion commit available from the canonical repository before Phase 5 pilot work.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Exact Phase 4 scope is reviewed; an authorised commit exists; its Phase 3 merge base is recorded; it is available remotely; full verification passes against that ref.
gates.remainingActions: Confirm the local commit and Phase 3 parent, rerun readiness checks, obtain separate push authorisation, publish the immutable ref, and complete independent review.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Blocks using Phase 4 as an expansion baseline.

gates.description: Phase 3 source was identified, compared with Phase 2, integrated, audited and hardened locally.
gates.owner: Phase 4 integration owner; independent reviewer unassigned
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Source/head/merge base and conflict record exist; migrations and access controls pass; independent reviewer confirms the record.
gates.remainingActions: Independent review remains; closure must reference the immutable Phase 4 commit.
gates.pilotImpact: Does not independently block planning; Phase 4 completion gate blocks execution.
gates.productionImpact: Independent integration review remains part of production assurance.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Must be closed before cloning the architecture to another region.

gates.description: Controlled service, council and routing data require canonical parity, resolving sources and current human verification.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Controlled audit passes and every pilot-critical record is reverified from primary sources through an approved revision.
gates.remainingActions: Assign an owner; reverify emergency, council, safeguarding and high-urgency records immediately before pilot.
gates.pilotImpact: Blocks real-user cohorts until pilot-critical records are reverified.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks publication of unverified critical records.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Each region requires its own approved controlled revision.

gates.description: Isolated environments, migrations, monitoring, backup, restore and rollback must be proven on hosted infrastructure.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Isolated staging/pilot resources exist; migrations, provider backup/PITR, restore, alerts, smoke tests and rollback pass with named owners.
gates.remainingActions: Provision hosted staging and perform provider-native recovery and rollback exercises.
gates.pilotImpact: Blocks all pilot cohorts beyond local synthetic testing.

gates.description: Authentication, account recovery, encryption keys, sessions, privileged roles and account lifecycle require complete operational assurance.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved identity/email providers, secure recovery, secrets/KMS, role lifecycle, deletion worker and adversarial tests pass in staging.
gates.remainingActions: Complete providers, KMS/key rotation, account lifecycle and privileged-access testing.
gates.pilotImpact: Blocks persistent real-user accounts and professional roles.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Requires tenant and key isolation per environment/region.

gates.description: The complete integrated service requires WCAG 2.2 AA manual, assistive-technology and lived-experience verification.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard, zoom/reflow, contrast, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, voice control, upload, print and compensated lived-experience tests pass with retests and approval.
gates.remainingActions: Run required manual/device research after an immutable staging release exists.
gates.pilotImpact: Blocks lived-experience and real-user cohorts until accessible support and critical journeys are verified.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Regional journeys and content require repeat testing.

gates.description: Privacy, lawful basis, editorial, complaints, data-sharing, AI and safeguarding governance require authorised human approval.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Current governance documents reflect actual data flows and are signed by authorised accountable owners.
gates.remainingActions: Complete the DPIA/ROPA and policies, identify the controller, and obtain all sign-offs.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Each regional controller/governance arrangement requires approval.

gates.description: Casework, timelines, deadlines, suitability, complaints and reviews require complete ownership, security, accessibility and journey assurance.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Route-level adversarial, concurrency, retention, accessibility and complete journey tests pass and receive independent review.
gates.remainingActions: Complete HTTP adversarial coverage, remaining journeys and independent review.
gates.pilotImpact: Restricts Cohort 1 to synthetic cases until immutable staging tests pass.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Regional casework variation requires separate assurance.

gates.description: Evidence storage requires private object storage, scanning, validation, authorised download, lifecycle, backup and deletion.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved storage/KMS/scanner controls and cross-user, revoked, expired, guessed-key, restore and deletion tests pass.
gates.remainingActions: Implement and independently test the currently disabled file-byte path.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks evidence file storage and downloads.

gates.description: Consent and advocate access must be granular, expiring, revocable, auditable and permission-history preserving.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Technical negative tests pass and an independent reviewer confirms invite, renewal, suspension, expiry, revocation and professional boundaries.
gates.remainingActions: Review against an immutable Phase 4 ref and complete professional-helper operational controls.
gates.pilotImpact: Advocate invitations remain disabled until review and support ownership exist.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks production sharing without independent/governance approval.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Regional partner roles require separate onboarding controls.

gates.description: External email requires an approved provider, user preview/approval, recipient and attachment safety, idempotency and audit.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Sandbox/provider, scopes, approvals, retry/idempotency, cancellation, revocation and wrong-recipient tests pass with human approval.
gates.remainingActions: Provision and test an approved provider; external sending remains disabled.
gates.pilotImpact: External sending and invitation delivery remain disabled.

gates.description: Generated exports require case/consent accuracy, privacy, injection resistance and accessibility verification.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Privacy, concurrency, injection, filename, selectable/searchable text, print, PDF/UA where applicable and assistive-technology tests pass.
gates.remainingActions: Complete privacy panel, cross-case concurrency and assistive-technology review.
gates.pilotImpact: Limit exports to controlled synthetic testing.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks public case packs and PDFs.

gates.description: Safeguarding needs named trained human ownership, lawful processes, escalation cover and clear application boundaries.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Lead/deputy/out-of-hours coverage and child, adult, abuse, trafficking, suicide, immediate-danger and conduct processes are approved and exercised.
gates.remainingActions: Appoint owners, approve lawful procedures, train staff and run a tabletop exercise.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks public release and real safeguarding workflows.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Each region needs approved local contacts and ownership.

gates.description: Approved retention, expiry, deletion, index removal, object removal, audit limits and backup expiry must be enforceable and tested.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved schedule and end-to-end jobs pass across sessions, drafts, cases, evidence, consents, accounts, indexes, logs, storage and backups.
gates.remainingActions: Approve periods/exceptions, implement workers and verify deletion including governed backup expiry.
gates.regionalExpansionImpact: Regional controller requirements may change schedules.

gates.description: An independent penetration test must cover the integrated staging release, roles, APIs, storage, exports and integrations.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved scope/accounts exist; independent test completes; critical/high findings are fixed and retested or specifically accepted by an authorised risk owner.
gates.remainingActions: Create immutable staging, engage a tester, remediate and retest findings.
gates.pilotImpact: Limits pilot to synthetic/internal scope until risk owner defines the independent-test entry point.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks public production while critical/high findings are unresolved or testing is unscheduled.

gates.description: Sussex content must remain unpublished until separate authoritative regional datasets, routing, verification and governance are approved.
gates.owner: Unassigned Sussex data and governance owners
gates.acceptanceCriteria: East Sussex, West Sussex and Brighton and Hove datasets are supplied; stable IDs and sources resolve; council/triage routes pass; human verification, safeguarding, accessibility and publication approval complete.
gates.remainingActions: Prepare templates only; do not add or publish Sussex operational records without authoritative inputs and owners.
gates.pilotImpact: Kent pilot scope must exclude Sussex routing.
gates.productionImpact: Sussex content must remain unavailable in Kent production.
